item.omnimine.bedrock_pickaxe.desc1: Unbreakable. Hold left click to mine mobs, the Sun, the Moon and lightning.
item.omnimine.bedrock_pickaxe.desc2: Sneak + hold left click on a structure: mine the whole thing.
item.omnimine.sun_sword.desc1: Power 1: every hit ignites the target and triggers a 7-block solar eruption (heavy damage, knockback, spreading fires). You are immune to fire.
item.omnimine.sun_sword.desc2: Power 2 (right click): a beam of the Sun strikes up to 96 blocks away: explosion, a 15-block molten crater, 90 damage and wildfire.
item.omnimine.moon_boots.desc1: Power 1: lunar gravity, super jump, two extra jumps in the air (each one hurls nearby enemies), no fall damage.
item.omnimine.moon_boots.desc2: Power 2: sneak in mid-air to dive and cause a 16-block lunar impact: crater, explosion, 60 damage.
item.omnimine.lightning_helmet.desc1: Chain lightning: every melee hit strikes your target (+12 damage) and lightning jumps from enemy to enemy (up to 10), blowing them up.
item.omnimine.lightning_helmet.desc2: Obtained by mining a lightning bolt.
item.omnimine.lightning_chestplate.desc1: Static discharge: when you are hit, a 14-block shockwave zaps and hurls everything around you, then eight explosive lightning strikes fall. Lightning immunity.
item.omnimine.lightning_chestplate.desc2: Obtained by mining a lightning bolt.
item.omnimine.lightning_leggings.desc1: Thunder run: +60% speed all the time and Speed IV while sprinting (crazy fast). You smash through walls ahead, the electric trail zaps enemies and lightning strikes the nearest one.
item.omnimine.lightning_leggings.desc2: Obtained by mining a lightning bolt.
message.omnimine.bolt_caught: Lightning struck the rod! It is frozen in place: mine it before it falls!
message.omnimine.sun_gone: The Sun has vanished from the sky...
message.omnimine.moon_gone: The Moon has vanished from the sky...
tooltip.omnimine.structure_useless: On its own, this structure is useless.
tooltip.omnimine.structure_craft: Crafting table: in the center, surrounded by 8 × %s → evolved version.
tooltip.omnimine.evolved: Evolved structure: a cheat structure ready to place.
tooltip.omnimine.evolved_use: Right click: it builds itself in front of you. The cheat items are in its chest.
message.omnimine.no_room: Not enough vertical room here to build the structure.
item.omnimine.mob_skeleton.desc1: Bone Storm: a rain of bones falls for 3 seconds on an 11-block radius, every bone digs a crater, and the zone ends in a big explosion.
item.omnimine.mob_creeper.desc1: Green Blast: the targeted area charges up, then a giant explosion (power 14, over three times TNT) digs a huge crater and sets off eight more around it.
item.omnimine.mob_zombie.desc1: Plague Breath: a 22-block cone of rotten mist inflicts Wither, weakness and slowness, withers all plants and heals you.
item.omnimine.mob_spider.desc1: Giant Web: 260 threads fall on a 10-block radius, pulling in, entangling and biting enemies.
item.omnimine.mob_guardian.desc1: Guardian Beam: a giant beam charges up, then pierces everything for 60 blocks (a tunnel 6 blocks wide, 40 damage) and explodes at the end.
item.omnimine.mob_villager.desc1: Village Scream: three sound waves out to 20 blocks push everything away, shatter glass, leaves and plants, and make emeralds pop out.
item.omnimine.mob_iron_golem.desc1: Golem Slam: the ground splits into 12 cracks 12 blocks deep over 16 blocks, dozens of blocks are torn up and everything is catapulted (40 damage).
item.omnimine.mob_enderman.desc1: Shadow Step: you teleport 50 blocks toward where you aim, digging a tunnel through everything; enemies you cross take 30 damage.
